contract.purpose: Carry structured dashboard file and image attachments from web composer submit paths into server prompt submission.
contract.scope: Dashboard submit payloads, tauri bridge transport, server attachment parsing, and submit routing.

invariants.invariant-1: Chat submit preserves attachment arrays alongside prompt text instead of flattening them into mentions.
invariants.invariant-2: Invalid attachment payload shapes fail request parsing with explicit 400 responses.
invariants.invariant-3: Settings/bootstrap surfaces expose current model image-input support so web composer can prewarn before send-time downgrade.
invariants.invariant-4: `/api/models` exposes per-model image-input capability flags alongside legacy model-id lists.
